title: the voiceover
oneLiner: Preps a VO copy with yt-vo, synthesizes it section by section, then locks the takes.
summary: Hands the final script to the `yt-vo` skill. `prep` writes a VO copy into each section's `spoken_text` (punctuation, numbers, pronunciation) plus `respell.json`, without touching `script.md` or `display_text`. Then synth runs per section via the Modal `synth_section` endpoint. Re-roll a single section with `--only`, listen, then lock.
